A <br> inside an inline code span splits the span and emits a hard break

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use HtmlToMarkdown\HtmlToMarkdown;
$result = HtmlToMarkdown::convert("<p>X <code>A<br>B<br>C</code></p>");
var_dump($result->content);
```
